description: Return Signal Lab's Trust Consensus score (0-100, grade A-E) for one audited MCP server by slug: each signal with points, source and date (Signal Lab's weekly audit and its history, the AI agent test, GitHub repository activity, presence in the official MCP Registry and whether the endpoint is on the vendor's own domain), the share of points we had data for, where the signals disagree, and an embeddable README badge URL. Third-party directory grades are not included. A summary of public signals, not a security certification. Get slugs from find_mcp_servers.
name: get_trust_score
title: Get an MCP server's Trust Consensus score
